breed.appearance: A young, slender kitten with a short, dense coat in brown-gray mackerel tabby: a grayish-taupe base with crisp black vertical stripes on the body, bold black bars on the front legs, and a distinct 'M' marking on the forehead with dark lines running back over the head. She has large, tall, pointed ears with pinkish insides, round olive-to-amber green eyes rimmed in black with a darker line trailing from each outer corner, a warm tan bridge on the nose, a dark nose leather, a pale cream muzzle and chin, and long white whiskers. She wears a thin lime-green collar and sits upright and alert on a fluffy cream blanket.
breed.fun_fact: Tabby cats aren't a breed but a coat pattern, and that signature 'M' on Greta's forehead is a mark every true tabby proudly wears!
